stem: A child will undergo MRI with sedation. Which approach to the expected depth of sedation is most appropriate?

options.text: Presume the child is deeply sedated, and make sure the practitioner can rescue from apnea, laryngospasm, or airway obstruction.
Presume moderate sedation, because responses to stimulation can be reliably checked while the child is in the scanner.
Presume deep sedation, but treat airway rescue skills as unnecessary because protective reflexes stay intact.
Presume minimal sedation unless the child becomes apneic, and then reassess the depth.
